summary: 의학적 근거로 보면 이 앱의 핵심 로직은 설계를 조정해야 합니다. 가임기는 '배란일로 끝나는 6일'로 정의됩니다(Wilcox 1995 NEJM, ASRM 2022). 임신 확률은 배란 5일 전 약 10%에서 배란일 무렵 약 33%까지 오르고, 배란 뒤에는 거의 0으로 떨어집니다. 가장 높은 날은 배란 1~2일 전입니다. 그런데 '다음 생리 예정일 − 14일' 같은 달력식 예측은 부정확합니다. 가임기가 교과서적 구간(10~17일) 안에 완전히 들어오는 여성은 약 30%뿐이고(Wilcox 2000 BMJ), 앱 61만 주기 분석에서 난포기 길이가 10~30일로 크게 흔들렸습니다(Bull 2019). 달력 기반 앱의 배란일 적중률은 21% 이하였고, 앱·웹사이트 53개 중 가임기를 정확히 맞힌 곳은 4개였습니다(Johnson 2018, Setton 2016). 반면 소변 LH 배란테스트로 관계 시기를 맞추면 출생률이 유의하게 높아졌습니다(Cochrane 2023, RR 1.36). 그래서 앱은 LH 테스트 결과를 입력받아 예측을 보정하는 구조가 바람직합니다. 권장 관계 빈도는 가임기에 1~2일마다(ASRM)지만 주 2~3회도 거의 같은 효과를 냅니다. 2026년 3월 개정된 NICE NG257은 주기 전체에 걸쳐 2~3일마다를 권합니다. 따라서 부부 양쪽에 '오늘이 D-day' 식 압박 알림을 보내면 오히려 스트레스와 성기능 저하를 부를 수 있습니다. 병원에 가라고 안내할 기준은 이렇습니다. 여성이 35세 미만이면 12개월, 35세 이상이면 6개월(ASRM), 한국 모자보건법상 난임 정의는 1년, NICE는 36세 이상이면 더 일찍 의뢰하도록 합니다. 영양제 쪽에서 여성은 엽산 400µg을 최소 1개월 전부터 임신 12주까지 먹으면 되고(CDC, USPSTF, WHO, NHS, 한국은 흔히 3개월 전부터), 고용량 비타민 A(레티놀 1만 IU 초과)는 피해야 합니다. 남성의 아연·엽산 보충은 대규모 RCT(FAZST 2020)에서 효과가 없었고, 항산화제 근거도 낮은 확실성에 그쳤습니다. 남성 체크리스트는 금연, 절주, 사우나·온욕 회피 같은 생활습관 중심으로 짜고, 정자 생성 주기(약 74일, 약 3개월)를 기준으로 삼는 편이 근거에 맞습니다. 참고로 이번 조사에서 WebFetch는 프록시에 막혀 원문을 열지 못했고 웹 검색 한도도 다 썼습니다. 그래서 모든 주장은 아래 URL들의 검색 결과 요약·발췌에 근거하며, 원문으로 확인하지 못한 수치는 확신도를 낮추거나 뺐습니다.

findings.claim: Wilcox et al. 1995 (NEJM 333:1517-21) followed 221 healthy women planning pregnancy and tracked ovulation with urinary estrogen and progesterone metabolites. Conception occurred only when intercourse fell within the 6-day interval ending on the estimated day of ovulation. The probability of conception rose from about 0.10 for intercourse 5 days before ovulation to about 0.33 on the day of ovulation. The intermediate day-by-day values could not be checked against the original table, so they are left out here.

Dunson et al. 1999 (Human Reproduction 14(7):1835) reanalysed two cohorts after correcting for error in identifying ovulation: London natural-family-planning couples in the 1950s-60s (ovulation by BBT) and North Carolina couples in the early 1980s (ovulation by urinary hormones). Both datasets gave the same 6-day fertile interval. In both, the pregnancy probability was highest for intercourse on the day before ovulation and fell close to zero after ovulation.

Dunson, Colombo and Baird 2002 (Human Reproduction 17(5):1399-1403) studied 782 couples using natural family planning over 5,860 cycles, with ovulation identified by BBT. Nearly all pregnancies occurred within a 6-day fertile window, and the window was not shorter at older ages. Day-specific pregnancy probabilities declined from the late 20s: they were about twice as high for women aged 19-26 as for women aged 35-39. Fertility was also significantly reduced for men over 35.

The ASRM Practice Committee opinion 'Optimizing natural fertility' (2022) defines the fertile window as the 6-day interval ending on the day of ovulation. Peak fecundability was seen for intercourse within the 2 days before ovulation. Intercourse every 1-2 days in the fertile window gives the highest pregnancy rates, but 2-3 times per week is nearly equivalent. For couples who cannot have frequent intercourse, fertility-awareness methods can help time it to the window.

Wilcox, Dunson and Baird 2000 (BMJ 321:1259) used 696 cycles from 221 women. In only about 30% of women did the fertile window fall entirely within cycle days 10-17, the days clinical guidelines typically name. On every day from day 6 to day 21, at least about 10% of women were in their fertile window. The authors advised telling women that the fertile window can be highly unpredictable even when cycles are usually regular. A secondary summary (AAFP) adds that women with regular cycles had up to about a 6% chance of being fertile on the day their period was due.

Bull et al. 2019 (npj Digital Medicine, Natural Cycles app data with UCL) analysed 612,613 ovulatory cycles from 124,648 users. Mean cycle length was 29.3 days. The mean follicular phase was 16.9 days (95% CI 10-30) and the mean luteal phase 12.4 days (95% CI 7-17). From age 25 to 45, cycle length fell by about 0.18 days per year and follicular length by about 0.19 days per year. The company's own summary says only about 13% of cycles were 28 days long and average ovulation was around day 18; that figure comes from the company, not the paper's abstract.

Lenton et al. 1984 (BJOG) put the normal luteal phase at about 12-17 days (mean 14.13 ± 1.41 days, 327 cycles). Fehring et al. 2006 found a mean of 12.4 ± 2.0 days. The follicular phase varies more than the luteal phase, and both vary within the same woman. So the 'ovulation = next period − 14 days' assumption is off by several days for many cycles.

Setton, Tierney and Tsai 2016 (Obstetrics & Gynecology) tested 33 popular free apps and 20 websites with a standardized 28-day cycle, taking the true fertile window as cycle days 10-15. Only 4 of the 53 (1 website and 3 apps) predicted the fertile window exactly. Most did name day 15 as ovulation day (80.0% of websites, 86.9% of apps). However, 26 of the 33 apps and 15 of the 20 websites included days after ovulation in the fertile window.

Johnson, Marriott and Zinaman 2018 (Current Medical Research and Opinion) assigned LH-surge days in one full cycle for each of 949 women. Apps predicted the ovulation day correctly no more than 21% of the time. The most commonly predicted day was day 15 (32 apps, 44%), but ovulation actually happened on day 15 only 19% of the time. Methods that use cycle length alone cannot accurately predict the ovulation day. The authors are affiliated with Clearblue (SPD), which makes LH tests.

findings.topic: Urinary LH tests and timed intercourse (Cochrane 2023)
findings.claim: The Cochrane review by Gibbons et al. 2023 (CD011345.pub3) pooled 7 RCTs with 2,464 women or couples. Compared with intercourse without ovulation prediction, timing intercourse with urinary ovulation (LH) tests probably increases live birth (RR 1.36, 95% CI 1.02-1.81, moderate-certainty evidence). In absolute terms, a 16% chance becomes about 16-28%. This applied to women under 40 trying for less than 12 months. The review could not tell whether the tests change stress levels (very low-quality evidence).

Ovulation usually follows the start of the LH surge by about 24-36 hours. A rise in blood LH takes about 12 hours to show up in urine, so a first positive home test usually means ovulation within roughly the next 1-1.5 days. The day of the positive test and the day after are therefore high-fertility days, and in practice the 1-2 days before are too. These figures come from secondary clinical and educational sources.

BBT rises by about 0.3-0.6°C (0.5-1.0°F) only after ovulation, roughly 1-2 days after the egg is released. It confirms ovulation after the fact and cannot warn in advance of the fertile days in the current cycle. It is useful for learning a woman's pattern across cycles, or combined with LH tests or cervical mucus.

Clear, slippery, stretchy ('egg-white') cervical mucus appears in the days before ovulation. The last day of that slippery sensation is the 'Peak day'. Bigelow et al. 2004 (Human Reproduction) reported that fertile-type mucus on the day of intercourse predicted conception better than calendar timing alone. That claim comes from secondary summaries; the original was not opened.

findings.topic: NICE guidance on intercourse frequency (2026 update)
findings.claim: NICE guideline NG257, 'Fertility problems: assessment and treatment', was published on 31 March 2026 and replaces CG156 (2013). It keeps the recommendation that vaginal intercourse every 2-3 days optimises the chance of pregnancy, across the whole cycle rather than only around ovulation. Timing around ovulation is recommended only for artificial insemination. NICE also states that, where the woman is aged under 40, over 80% of couples conceive within 1 year of regular unprotected intercourse, and about half of the rest conceive in year 2 (over 90% cumulatively).

NICE recommends offering fertility investigations after 1 year of unprotected intercourse every 2-3 days. It recommends earlier referral if the woman is 36 or older, or if there is a known cause or predisposing factor for infertility, such as irregular or absent periods.

findings.topic: When to seek evaluation (ASRM 2023) and Korean legal definition
findings.claim: ASRM's 2023 committee opinion 'Definition of infertility' says evaluation should start after 12 months of regular unprotected intercourse if the female partner is under 35, and after 6 months if she is 35 or older. Korea's Mother and Child Health Act (모자보건법, Article 2) defines 난임 as no pregnancy after 1 year of normal sexual life without contraception. The widely cited ASRM practice of immediate evaluation for women over 40 or with known risk factors was not checked in this session.

Coordinating intercourse through ovulation tracking has been linked to more emotional distress. Sexual function (desire, arousal, lubrication, orgasm, satisfaction) declined over time in couples trying to conceive, more in women than in men, and men can feel acute stress or sexual dysfunction during the partner's fertile days. Other studies found that education on conception strategies did not raise stress, and the Cochrane evidence on stress is very low quality. The evidence is mixed overall.

The USPSTF (reaffirmed 1 August 2023, grade A) recommends that everyone planning or able to become pregnant take 0.4-0.8 mg (400-800 µg) of folic acid daily. It should start at least 1 month before conception and continue through the first 2-3 months of pregnancy. The CDC recommends 400 µg daily before and during early pregnancy, and 4,000 µg daily after a previous pregnancy affected by a neural tube defect, starting at least 1 month before conception. WHO recommends 400 µg per day periconceptionally, started as early as possible and ideally before conception.

findings.topic: Folic acid, vitamin D and vitamin A (NHS)
findings.claim: The NHS advises women trying to conceive to take 400 µg of folic acid daily, ideally from 3 months before conception, until 12 weeks of pregnancy. It advises 10 µg of vitamin D daily, especially from October to March. It warns that vitamin A (retinol) supplements may be harmful in pregnancy. Other vitamins are not routinely advised.

findings.topic: Folic acid in Korea and public support
findings.claim: Korean public-health messaging, citing 질병관리청 (KDCA), recommends starting 400 µg of folic acid about 3 months before pregnancy and continuing to 12 weeks. Local public health centres (보건소) provide 3 months' supply of folic acid to women preparing for pregnancy or registered as pregnant. Some local governments (e.g. Gwangyang, January 2026) also give folic acid to men. The national 임신 사전건강관리 지원사업 covers men and women aged 20-49: AMH and gynecologic ultrasound for women, and semen analysis (up to about ₩50,000) for men. These details come from 보건소 and news pages and should be checked on the official portals.

Preformed vitamin A (retinol and retinyl esters) up to 10,000 IU per day has not been associated with birth defects. Intakes above 10,000 IU per day are not recommended in pregnancy. Rothman et al. 1995 (NEJM) estimated about 1 in 57 exposed pregnancies affected above that level, though other studies did not confirm this. β-carotene does not carry the same toxicity.

The FAZST trial (Schisterman et al., JAMA, January 2020) randomized 2,370 men from couples seeking infertility treatment to 5 mg folic acid plus 30 mg elemental zinc daily, or placebo, for 6 months. The supplements did not improve semen quality or live birth. They increased sperm DNA fragmentation and gastrointestinal symptoms.

The Cochrane review by de Ligny et al. 2022 (CD007411.pub5) covered 90 RCTs of 18 antioxidants, including CoQ10, in 10,303 subfertile men. Antioxidants may be associated with higher live birth and clinical pregnancy rates, but the evidence is low to very low certainty and comes mostly from small or medium trials. The baseline was about 16 live births per 100 couples without antioxidants. The authors call for large, well-designed placebo-controlled trials.

Human spermatogenesis takes about 74 days, and about 3 months including transport and maturation in the epididymis. Some newer estimates range from about 42 to 76 days. Male lifestyle changes therefore need roughly one full cycle, about 3 months, to show in semen quality.

Garolla et al. 2013 (Human Reproduction) found that Finnish sauna for 15 minutes twice a week for 3 months significantly impaired sperm count, motility, mitochondrial function and DNA packaging in men with normal semen. The effects reversed: values were still low 3 months after stopping and back to normal at 6 months. Sperm production needs the testes about 2-6°C cooler than core body temperature. Wet heat (hot tubs, hot baths) is described as a reversible cause of low semen quality.

ASRM committee opinions (2018, replaced by a 2024 opinion on tobacco or marijuana use) report that male smokers have dose-dependent reductions in semen parameters, including about 22% lower sperm concentration on average. Values often stay within the normal range, and a direct effect on male fertility is not conclusively shown. For women, a meta-analysis of 10,928 smokers and 19,128 non-smokers found smokers significantly more likely to be infertile, and smokers reach menopause 1-4 years earlier. NICE 2026 tells male smokers that smoking is associated with reduced semen quality. (2026-11-01) The 2024 ASRM opinion also says e-cigarettes (ENDS) may affect male reproduction, but the evidence is still limited — see 'male-e-cigarettes'.

ACOG Committee Opinion 462 (2010, reaffirmed) says moderate caffeine (under 200 mg per day) does not appear to be a major factor in miscarriage or preterm birth, while the link to growth restriction is undetermined. Korea's MFDS (식약처) sets daily caffeine limits of 400 mg or less for adults and 300 mg or less for pregnant women. NICE NG257 (2026) states there is no consistent evidence that caffeinated drinks cause fertility problems.

The CDC states there is no known safe amount of alcohol during pregnancy or while trying to get pregnant, and no safe time or type of alcohol. Alcohol can cause fetal alcohol spectrum disorders. NICE NG257's specific alcohol wording for natural conception was not fully visible in the results.

NICE NG257 (2026) says women with a BMI of 30 or more should be told they are likely to take longer to conceive. If they are not ovulating, losing weight is likely to improve their chance of conception.

findings.topic: Due date and gestational age (Naegele's rule)
findings.claim: By convention, the estimated due date is 280 days (40 weeks) after the first day of the last menstrual period (Naegele's rule). Gestational age is counted from that date. The rule assumes a 28-day cycle with ovulation on day 14 and ignores cycle and ovulation variability. ACOG Committee Opinion 700 (2017) treats first-trimester ultrasound as the most accurate method: if it differs from the LMP date by more than about 5 days in early first trimester, the ultrasound date should be used.

findings.topic: 정액검사 전 준비 — 보통 2~7일 쉬는 기간 (WHO 6판)
findings.claim: WHO 정액검사 매뉴얼 6판(2021-07)은 2~7일 금욕 뒤 채취를 표준으로 해요(5판과 같음). 서울대병원 안내는 3일 뒤 채취해 되도록 1시간 안에 검사하고, 국내 비뇨의학과 의원 안내는 3~5일이 흔해요. Fertility and Sterility 논평은 2~7일이 임신 결과에 근거한 범위가 아니라고 지적해요. 병원이 2일보다 긴 준비를 말하면 이틀 전 알림은 늦어서, 앱은 예약일 7일 전(예약이 그보다 가까우면 예약할 때) 남편에게 '병원에서 알려 준 검사 전 준비를 지금 확인해요. 병원마다 달라요.'를 보내요.
findings.notes: 검색 요약(원문 미열람). 화면에 날짜 수(2~7일)를 쓰지 않고, 성행위를 지시하는 표현을 쓰지 않아요(AGENTS.md 금지어). 아내 쪽 PartnerProgress에는 단계만 보여요. lib/logic/partnerDates TEST_PREP_NOTICE_DAYS = 7.

findings.topic: 먹는 약·근육 키우는 약·주사는 검사받을 때 의사에게 말하기
findings.claim: AUA/ASRM 남성 난임 가이드라인(2020, 2024 개정) Statement 42: 지금이나 나중에 아이를 원하는 남성에게 외부 테스토스테론을 처방하지 말 것 — 외부 테스토스테론은 시상하부-뇌하수체 신호를 눌러 정자 생성을 줄이고 무정자증까지 가는 일이 흔해요. EAU 2025도 같은 권고이고, NICE NG257(2026-03-31)은 진료 때 묻는 약 예시에 단백동화스테로이드·테스토스테론 보충·피나스테리드·GLP-1 계열을 넣어요. 끊은 뒤 회복은 개인차가 커요(후향 연구). FDA 프로페시아 라벨(2014)의 핵심 주의는 임신 가능성이 있는 여성이 부서진 정제를 만지지 않는 것이고, 남성이 임신 준비 때 끊으라는 문구는 없어요. EMA PRAC(2024-01)는 임신 전 3개월 안에 아버지가 발프로산을 쓴 경우 예방 조치를 냈어요(인과 불확실, 끊으면 발작 위험 — 반드시 처방 의사와). 영국 UKTIS·호주 Healthy Male은 남성이 먹는 약 대부분은 영향이 적을 가능성이 높고, 임신 준비를 이유로 마음대로 끊지 말고 의사와 상의하라고 해요. 식약처는 2022-06 근육 강화를 내세운 스테로이드 불법 온라인 판매를 적발했어요(보도) — 처방 없이 쓰는 경우가 있어서 '처방한 의사와 정해요'만으로는 부족하고 '검사받을 때 의사에게 말해요'가 먼저예요.
findings.notes: 가이드라인 문장은 high, 회복 기간 숫자는 medium — 모두 검색 요약(nice.org.uk·ema.europa.eu·accessdata.fda.gov·asrm.org 원문은 세션 네트워크에서 열리지 않음). 화면 문장(남편 체인 ② 검사 카드 — 앱·남편 링크, 그리고 남편 본인 챙길 것 '임신 전 검사 (정액·감염병)' 줄의 '자세히' 안 — partnerTrack.partnerDetailNote. 함께 보는 로드맵 detail에는 넣지 않아요): '먹는 약이나 근육 키우는 약·주사가 있으면 검사받을 때 의사에게 말해요. 처방받은 약은 혼자 끊지 말고 처방한 의사와 정해요.' 약 이름·회복 개월 수·'불임이 돼요'는 쓰지 않아요. 체크 행·첫 실행 질문으로 만들지 않고 아무것도 저장하지 않아요. 아내 화면(챙길 것 포함)·아내의 링크 미리보기·'이번 주 민수님'·알림 어디에도 약 이야기가 가지 않아요. 'finasteride is common among Korean men'은 근거가 없어서 쓰지 않아요.

findings.topic: 전자담배도 담배 질문에 넣기 (근거는 아직 적어요)
findings.claim: ASRM 2024(담배·대마와 난임)는 전자담배(ENDS)도 남성 생식 기능에 영향이 있다고 적어요(단편만 확인). 2025 Sci Rep 국내 IVF 코호트(296명)는 일반 담배와만 비교하고 비흡연자 대조가 없어서 '덜 해롭다'의 근거가 되지 못해요. 액상·궐련형만 쓰는 사람이 '안 피워요'로 답해 금연 체크인을 못 받는 일을 막으려고 첫 실행 질문에만 '(전자담배 포함)'을 넣어요. 행 이름('금연'·'담배 안 피우기')과 '흡연은 정액 질을 떨어뜨려요' 문장은 그대로 둬요 — 그 문장이 전자담배까지 말하는 것으로 넓어지지 않게요.
findings.notes: 전자담배도 남성 생식에 영향을 줄 수 있다는 연구가 있지만 아직 근거가 적어요(ASRM 2024, 검색 요약). 화면에는 질문의 '(전자담배 포함)' 두 낱말만 — components/onboarding/partnerChoices SMOKE_QUESTION. lib/initial SMOKE_CHECK_LABELS는 바꾸지 않아요.

findings.topic: 임신 중·아기 곁 간접흡연 — 집·차 안과 베란다는 연기 없이
findings.claim: CDC: 임신 중 간접흡연은 출생 체중을 조금 낮추고 조산과 연관될 수 있고, 태어난 뒤 간접흡연은 영아돌연사(SIDS)·귀·폐 감염 위험을 높여요. 안전한 노출 수준은 없어요. 메타분석(Leonardi-Bee 2011 Pediatrics, 관찰 연구 19개)에서 간접흡연에 노출된 비흡연 임신부의 사산·선천 이상이 조금 높았어요. 캐나다 CHILD 코호트(2021)에서는 밖에서만 피우는 집 아기의 소변 코티닌이 담배 없는 집의 약 3배였어요(옷·손에 남는 3차 흡연). 질병관리청 국가건강정보포털은 흡연을 영아돌연사 위험 요인으로 들고, 집(베란다 포함)·차에서 피우지 말라고 해요. 그래서 목표는 금연이고, 그 전에도 집·차 안과 베란다는 지금부터 연기 없이 — '밖에서 피우면 괜찮아요'로 읽히지 않게 써요.
findings.notes: 방향은 high, 배수·오즈비는 화면에 쓰지 않아요(검색 요약). 흡연자의 주간 금연 체크인 줄(임신 단계부터): '끊는 게 목표예요. 집·차 안과 베란다는 지금부터 연기 없이 지내요.' 아내 화면에는 습관 이름이 보이지 않아요('체크인했어요'). 남편 탓·죄책감 톤 금지.

findings.claim: 보건소 금연클리닉은 무료로 6개월 동안 상담·금연보조제(12주)·일산화탄소 측정을 해 준다는 안내가 많아요(지역마다 달라요). 가까운 금연클리닉은 금연길라잡이(nosmokeguide.go.kr)의 금연클리닉 찾기에서 봐요. 금연상담전화는 1544-9030(평일 09~22시, 주말·공휴일 09~18시라는 보건소 안내가 있어요).
findings.notes: 검색 요약(원문 미열람). 화면은 링크 한 줄 '보건소 금연클리닉 찾기' → https://www.nosmokeguide.go.kr/helpness/clinic (준비·임신 단계 모두, 흡연자의 금연 체크인 아래). 금연보조제·약 이름 추천 금지, 무료 기간·횟수는 화면에 쓰지 않아요.

findings.topic: 임신이 확인되면 사우나·노트북 체크는 내려놓을지 묻기
findings.claim: 사우나·뜨거운 탕 쉬기와 노트북 무릎 위에 두지 않기는 정자 쪽 이유(고환 온도)의 임신 준비용 체크예요: Garolla 2013(사우나 3개월 → 정자 지표 저하, 끊고 6개월에 회복, 위 'Heat exposure' 항목), Sheynkin 2005(무릎 위 노트북은 음낭 온도만 2.6~2.8°C 올림, 정액은 재지 않음). ASRM 2022(자연 임신 최적화)는 정상 남성에게 고환 열을 줄이려는 행동 변화를 지지하지 않아요(검색 요약). 임신이 확인되면 이 이유는 이번 임신과 관계가 없어져서, 행을 지우지 않고 한 번만 '사우나·노트북 체크는 임신 준비용이었어요. 내려놓을까요?'를 물어요. 금연·술 쉬기는 임신 중에도 이유가 있어서(간접흡연, 같이 쉬기) 묻지 않아요.
findings.notes: 새 의학 주장은 없어요(내려놓기 제안만). '이제 사우나 해도 돼요' 같은 의학 허락 표현 금지. 행 이름은 두 가지예요 — '사우나·뜨거운 탕 쉬기'(주간)와 '사우나·뜨거운 탕 피하기'(매일, 예전 목록·예시·추가 행), 그리고 '노트북 무릎 위에 두지 않기'.

findings.topic: 아빠도 출산 전후에 우울해질 수 있어요 — 출생 뒤 한 번 묻기
findings.claim: 메타분석: 아빠의 출산 전후 우울은 약 10%(Paulson & Bazemore 2010 JAMA, 43개 연구 2만8천 명 — 출산 후 3~6개월이 가장 높음), 8.4%(Cameron 2016 J Affect Disord, 임신부터 출산 후 12개월까지 비슷). 엄마의 우울과 중간 정도로 함께 움직여요(r 0.31). 연구마다 숫자가 8~26%로 갈려요. 그래서 앱은 출생 뒤 90일에 그에게만 '요즘 나는 어때요?'를 한 번 묻고, 답은 저장하지 않아요(물어봤다는 것만).
findings.notes: 검색 요약(원문 미열람). 화면에 %·'10명 중 1명' 단정을 쓰지 않아요. 남성 증상 목록으로 진단하지 않아요. 아내 화면·요약·내보내기·'이번 주 민수님' 어디에도 가지 않아요. 유산 뒤 42일에는 묻지 않아요. lib/logic/partnerDates DAD_MIND_OFFSET = 90, DAD_MIND_LAST_OFFSET = 364(출생 후 12개월까지 — Cameron 2016이 다룬 기간, 그 뒤에는 묻지 않아요).

findings.claim: 정신건강위기상담전화 1577-0199는 24시간이고 정신건강전문요원이 받아 가까운 정신건강복지센터로 이어 줘요. 자살예방상담전화 109는 2024-01-01부터 여러 번호를 대신해 하나로 합쳐졌고 24시간이에요(죽고 싶은 생각이 들 때의 번호). 1577-0199는 109로 합쳐지지 않았어요(보건복지상담센터 129 FAQ). 위급하면 119예요. 중앙난임·임산부심리상담센터(02-2276-2276)는 배우자도 상담받을 수 있어요.
findings.notes: 검색 요약(129.go.kr·mmhwc.or.kr 원문 미열람) — 출시 전 번호를 공식 원문으로 다시 확인해요. 화면(아빠 마음 시트): '정신건강위기상담 1577-0199 · 24시간' / '죽고 싶은 생각이 들면 109 · 24시간' / '위급하면 119' / '난임·임산부심리상담센터 · 배우자도 상담받을 수 있어요'. 109를 일반 상담 번호처럼 쓰지 않아요.

implications: Do not rely on a calendar-only 'next period − 14' algorithm. Show the fertile window as a 6-day range with probabilities that peak 1-2 days before ovulation, widen it for irregular or short-history cycles, and state that the prediction is an estimate (Wilcox 2000: only about 30% fall within days 10-17; app accuracy at most 21%).

Build in LH-test input as the main way to correct predictions: the day of a positive test plus the next day are peak days. Offer BBT and cervical mucus logging to confirm ovulation after the fact and learn the pattern over cycles. Timing with LH tests has moderate-certainty evidence of higher live birth (Cochrane 2023, RR 1.36).

Make intercourse-frequency guidance deliberately low-pressure. Default to 'every 2-3 days, or every 1-2 days around the window' (NICE 2026 / ASRM). Avoid single-'D-day' alerts to the husband, since timed-intercourse pressure is linked to distress and sexual dysfunction. Give each partner control over whether and how they get fertile-day alerts, and phrase alerts as couple time rather than a task. This fits the date-idea feature well.

Add automatic 'see a doctor' prompts: 12 months of trying if the woman is under 35 (6 months if 35 or older, ASRM; 1 year under Korea's 모자보건법; NICE says earlier referral at 36+), plus immediate prompts for irregular or absent cycles or known conditions. Link to Korea's 임신 사전건강관리 지원사업 (AMH, ultrasound, semen analysis) and 보건소 folic acid supply.

Base the women's supplement checklist on folic acid 400 µg daily, started at least 1 month before (Korean norm: 3 months) and continued to 12 weeks, plus optional vitamin D. Warn about retinol vitamin A above 10,000 IU and multivitamin overlap. Record 4 mg as the dose for a previous neural-tube-defect pregnancy only under a doctor's instruction.

For men, a zinc/folate 'take your vitamins' check is not evidence-based (FAZST found no benefit and some harm), and antioxidant evidence is low certainty. Build the male check around behaviours instead: no smoking, alcohol reduction, avoiding sauna, hot tubs and laptop heat, and a 74-day / 3-month progress timer. Avoid supplement-selling claims that could mislead users or raise regulatory risk.
Use conservative lifestyle trackers: caffeine at 200 mg a day or less (ACOG; MFDS allows 300 mg for pregnant women), zero alcohol once trying (CDC), and no smoking for either partner.

For the switch to pregnancy and the baby diary, calculate the due date as LMP + 280 days and gestational weeks from the LMP. Let the user overwrite it with the ultrasound due date from the first-trimester scan (ACOG CO 700), because the app's cycle data will often be off by several days.
Add age-aware copy for women 35 and over: per-cycle chances are about half those of women aged 19-26 (Dunson 2002), and evaluation should come at 6 months. Keep the tone supportive, not alarming.

Source caveat: WebFetch was blocked in this session and the search budget ran out, so the numbers come from search-result abstracts and summaries of the cited URLs. Check the original papers and guideline texts (especially NICE NG257, ASRM definitions, and the Korean 보건소 support details) before putting them in the app.

2026-11-01 (남편 체크 포인트 12개): 정액검사 7일 전 준비 확인(male-semen-test-abstinence), 약·근육 키우는 약은 검사받을 때 의사에게 말하기(male-medicines-testosterone), 담배 질문에 '(전자담배 포함)'(male-e-cigarettes), 임신 중 집·차 연기 없이 + 보건소 금연클리닉 링크(secondhand-smoke-home-car, quit-smoking-clinic-kr), 임신 확인 뒤 사우나·노트북 체크 내려놓기(heat-check-retire-pregnancy), 출생 뒤 90일 아빠 마음 한 번(paternal-perinatal-depression, mental-health-lines-kr). 모두 검색 요약이라 verified:false예요.
